sections.title: Passage 1: Reducing electricity consumption on the Isle of Eigg
sections.html:
Approximately

(adverb). almost, but not completely

ex: The job will take approximately three weeks, and cost approximately £1,000.

resident

(noun). a person who lives in a particular place or who has their home there

ex: Every city had a large number of resident aliens.

proportion

(noun). A part, share, or number considered in comparative relation to a whole.

ex: His ears were drawn out of proportion with his head.

household

(noun). A house and its occupants regarded as a unit.

ex: household chores are boring

consumption

(noun). the action of using up a resource.

ex: As a nation, our consumption of junk food is horrifying.

consume

(verb). Eat, drink, or ingest (food or drink)

Ex: The teeth of children who consume acidic foods or drinks, become sensitive to hot and cold food and drink.

modem

(noun). a device that connects one computer system to another using a telephone line so that data can be sent

ex: Televison and Internet are provided by high-speed modem.

generate

(verb). cause emotion to arise or come about.

ex: This business should generate a lot of revenue

renewable

(adjective). of a natural resource or source of energy not depleted when used.

ex: We should use renewable energy sources such as wind and solar power

solar

(adjective). related to the sun

Ex: -The lilting notes of Cein's flute filled the air as Edith sat amongst her ladies-in-waiting in her private solar.

monitor

(verb). Observe and check the progress or quality of (something) over a period of time

ex: The nurse is monitoring his heart rate and respiration.

cumulative

(adjective). increasing or increased in quantity, degree, or force by successive additions

Ex: I wish they’d just give a little bit more so that you got the sense of a cumulative awareness.

usage

(noun). The action of using something or the fact of being used.

ex: The earliest recorded usage of the word is in the twelfth century.

diesel

(noun). an internal combustion engine in which heat produced by the compression of air in the cylinder is used to ignite the fuel

Ex: We need eleven gallons of diesel

generator

(noun). a machine or device that produces something

ex: You can use a random number generator

insufficient

(adjective). not large, strong or important enough for a particular purpose

ex: There was insufficient money to fund the project.

demand

(noun). an insistent and peremptory request, made as if by right

ex: There was little demand for tickets.

insulation

(noun). the act of protecting something with a material that prevents heat, sound, electricity, etc. from passing through; the materials used for this

Better insulation of your home will help to reduce heating bills.

free of charge

(phrase). without having to pay

Ex: Careers advice is provided free of charge.

Heritage

(noun). property that is or may be inherited; an inheritance.

ex: These monuments are a vital part of the cultural heritage of South America.

property

(noun). A thing or things belonging to someone; possessions collectively.

ex: Both books have "Government property" stamped inside them.

greenhouse

(noun). a glass building protecting plants from cold weather

ex: Gladys grows a lot of tomatoes in her greenhouse.

aid

(noun). Help, typically of a practical nature.

ex: He gets about with the aid of a walking stick.

grant

(noun). a sum of money given by a government or other organization for a particular purpose

Ex: They'd got a special grant to encourage research

inhabitant

(noun). A person or animal that lives in or occupies a place

ex: it's a city of five million inhabitants

scheme

(noun). A large-scale systematic plan or arrangement for attaining some particular object

ex: Under the current marking/mark scheme, you need 90 percent to get an A.

emission

(noun). The production and discharge of something,

ex: Bioluminescence is the emission of light from living organisms.

secondary

(adjective). Coming after, less important than, or resulting from someone or something else

Ex: Ownership is important, but it's secondary to generating competition.

locally

(adverb). With reference to a particular area or one's neighbourhood.

ex: Do they live locally?

import

(verb). bring (goods or services) into a country from abroad for sale

ex: Japan's reluctance to import more cars

grid

(noun). A framework of spaced bars that are parallel to or cross each other; a grating.

ex: In Barcelona the streets are laid out in/on a grid system.

installation

(noun). the action or process of installing someone or something, or of being installed.

ex: The room contained the company's large computer installation.

significant

(adjective). large or important enough to have an effect or to be noticed

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

harvest

(verb). The process or period of gathering in crops.

ex: In the US, winter wheat is harvested in the early summer.

forestry

(noun). the science or practice of planting and taking care of trees and forests

Ex: He is looking for a job in the forestry field.

elimination

(noun). the process of removing or getting rid of something/somebody completely

Ex: the elimination of extreme poverty is a key objective

constant

(adjective). unchanged with time

ex: The equipment should be stored at a constant temperature.

reliable

(adjective). Consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted.

Ex: We are looking for someone who is reliable and hard-working.

Well-off

(adjective). rich

Ex: Her family was very well off.

incentive

(noun). something that encourages you to do something

Ex:There is no incentive for people to save fuel.

equitable

(adjective). fair and reasonable; treating everyone in an equal way

Ex: The competition was very equitable since both teams were the same age and skill level.

access

(noun). the means or opportunity to approach or enter a place

ex: The main access to (= entrance to) the building is at the side.

employment

(noun). the state of being employed

ex: How long have you been looking for employment?

maintenance

(noun). The process of preserving a condition

Ex: The school pays for heating and the maintenance of the buildings.

Likewise

(adverb). In the same way; also.

ex: I stuck out my tongue and Frankie did likewise.

Isle

(noun). used especially in poetry and names to mean ‘island’

Ex: She has visited the British Isles

mainland

(noun). A large continuous extent of land that includes the greater part of a country or territory à island, boundary, peninsula

Ex: Subsoils on the mainland tend to be limestone, while on the islands they are mainly volcanic

labour

(noun). work, especially hard physical work.

ex: The car parts themselves are not expensive, it's the labour that costs the money.

sufficiency

(noun). The condition or quality of being adequate or sufficient.

Ex: This raises the question of how primates are able to locate a sufficiency of ripe fruits each day

apparent

(adjective). Clearly visible or understood; obvious.

ex: it became apparent that he was talented

instantaneous

(adjective). Occurring or done instantly.

Ex: The first instantaneous velocity equal to or greater than 10 mm/s defined the beginning of the movement.

have a keen sense

(phrase). have a good ability to understand something or how to use something.

Ex: Working-class people have a keen sense of humour.

appliance

(noun). a device, machine, or piece of equipment, especially an electrical one that is used in the house

Ex: The string of drilling tools consists of two Drilling parts separated by an appliance known as the jars

minimise

(verb). reduce to the smallest possible amount

ex: the aim is to minimize costs

postpone

(verb). to delay an event and plan or decide that it should happen at a later date or time

Ex: We've had to postpone going to France because the children are ill.

measure

(noun). a way of achieving something, or a method for dealing with a situation

Ex: We should take strict measures against contraband

insulate

(verb). Protect (something) by interposing material that prevents the loss of heat

Ex: he city was insulated by heavy seasonal overspill.

affordable

(adjective). Inexpensive; reasonably priced.

ex: Distributed computing makes enormous computational problems affordable to solve.

economic

(adjective). connected with the trade, industry

ex: They have no economic advantage in going to war.

accommodation

(noun). A room, group of rooms, or building in which someone may live or stay.

Ex: Her father would not let her return to the family home in April 2004 and she was forced to live alone in council accommodation.

specific

ex: The virus attacks specific cells in the brain.

prediction

ex: Please don't ask me to make any predictions about tomorrow's meeting.

practice

(noun). thực hành

ex: How do you intend to put these proposals into practice, Mohamed?

workforce

(verb). đường đi làm

ex: It's exhausting commuting from Brighton to London every day.

temporary

(adjective). tạm thời

ex: she is a temporary staff

flexible

(adjective). Linh hoạt

ex: My schedule is flexible - I could arrange to meet with you any day next week.

reference

ex: I am writing with/in reference to (= in connection with) your letter of 15 March.

structure

(verb). kết cấu

ex:he made a well-structured argument

mechanistic

(adjective). (thuộc) thuyết cơ giới

ex: The challenge has come from what was supposed to be the heart of the mechanistic world view - from physics.

hierarchical

(adjective). thứ bậc

ex: The military has a hierarchical rank structure.

firm

(adjective). chắc chắn

ex: These pears are still too firm to eat.

means

(noun). (phương tiện) method

ex: They had no means of communication

warning

(noun). cảnh báo

ex: Completely without warning, he turned up at my door with all four children!

crucial

(adjective). quan trọng

ex: Vitamins are crucial for maintaining good health.

analyse

(verb). phân tích

ex: Researchers analysed the purchases of 6,300 households.

trigger

(noun). Kích hoạt

ex: It's not clear who actually pulled the trigger.

organisational

(adjective). tổ chức

ex: A lot of what he does is organizationalex: he handles all the meetings.

era

(noun). kỷ nguyên

ex: The era of fractured power and corruption is about to end

notable

(adjective). đáng chú ý

ex: it's a notable collection of rare plants

relative

(noun). họ hàng

ex: All her close/distant relatives came to the wedding.

absence

(noun). vắng mặt

ex: A new manager was appointed during/in her absence.

stability

(noun). ổn định

ex: This has been a period of relative economic stability.

agricultural

(adjective). chuyên về nghề nông

ex: The world's supply of agricultural land is shrinking fast.

preceding

(adjective). ở trước

ex: The paintings are a development of ideas she explored in the preceding decade.

prevail

(verb). Chiếm ưu thế

ex: And did reason prevail over (= become a more powerful influence than) emotion?

satisfaction

(noun). sự thỏa mãn

ex: She looked at the finished painting with satisfaction.

priority

(noun). sự ưu tiên

ex: The management did not seem to consider office safety to be a priority.

preference

(noun). sở thích

ex: Her preference is for comfortable rather than stylish clothes.

surplus

(noun). số dư

ex: The world is now producing large food surpluses.

neo-industrial

(phrase). tân công nghiệp

ex: The following neo-industrial criteria for sustainable development should be considered

advancement

(noun). thăng tiến

ex: All she was interested in was the advancement of her own career.

productivity

(noun). năng suất

ex: Productivity in the steel industry improved by five percent last year.

overtake

(verb). vượt qua

ex: Our US sales have now overtaken our sales in Europe.

emphasis

(noun). nhấn mạnh

ex: The emphasis is on the final syllable.

quantity

(noun). định lượng

ex: Police found a large/small quantity of drugs in his possession.

Revolution

(noun). Cuộc cách mạng

ex: The country seems to be heading towards revolution.

industrial

(adjective). công nghiệp

ex: He has an industrial background (= he has worked in industry).

proximity

(noun). sự gần gũi

ex: Mexico is a popular vacation spot because of its proximity to California.

consumer

(noun). người tiêu thụ

ex: The new rates will affect all consumers, including businesses.

workplace

(noun). nơi làm việc

ex: We must meet safety standards in the workplace

context

(noun). bối cảnh

ex: What was the context you found the word in?

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

ex: What influenced you to choose a career in nursing?

labour

(noun). lao động chân tay

ex: manual labour (= hard work using the hands)

goods

(noun). Các mặt hàng

ex: They sell leather goods such as wallets, purses, and briefcases.

meteorological

(adjective). khí tượng

ex: Accurate meteorological records began 100 years ago.

metaphor

(noun). phép ẩn dụ

ex: "The mind is an ocean" and "the city is a jungle" are both metaphors.

characterise

(verb). phân loại

ex: Bright colours and bold strokes characterize his early paintings.

innovation

(noun). sự đổi mới

ex: The recording industry is driven by constant innovation.

transform

(verb). biến đổi

ex: The reorganization will transform the entertainment industry.

economist

(noun). nhà kinh tế học

ex: As an economist, he was able to shed some light on the problem.

quarter

(noun). phần tư

ex: My house is situated a mile and three-quarters from here.

Chief

(noun). lãnh tụ

ex: The weather was our chief reason for coming here.

Institute

(noun). học viện

ex: The institute will invest 5 million in the project.

Guardian

(noun). Người giám hộ

ex: The child's parents or guardians must give their consent before she has the operation.

influential

(adjective). có ảnh hưởng

ex: She wanted to work for a bigger and more influential (= powerful) newspaper.

breeze

(noun). gió nhẹ

ex: She let the gentle breeze cool her face.

gale

(noun). cơn lốc

ex: Hundreds of old trees were blown down in the gales.

devastation

(noun). sự tàn phá

ex: The storm left behind it a trail of devastation.

consequent

(adjective). hệ quả

ex: Stock values declined, with consequent financial losses.

subsistence

(noun). sinh tồn

ex: The family was living at subsistence level.

hitherto

(adverb). cho đến nay

ex: Mira revealed hitherto unsuspected talents on the dance floor.

obtainable

(adjective). có được

ex: Information on the subject is easily obtainable on the internet.

domestic

(adjective). trong nước

ex: The domestic market is still depressed, but demand abroad is picking up.

outstrip

(verb). vượt ra ngoài

ex: The demand for food in the war zone now far outstrips supply.

attribute

(noun). thuộc tính

ex: Organizational ability is an essential attribute for a good manager.

flavour

(noun). hương vị

ex: Add a little salt to bring out the flavour of the herbs.

intensive

(adjective). chuyên sâu

ex: We have to go through two weeks of intensive training

witness

(verb). làm chứng

ex: Police are appealing for witnesses to the accident to come forward.

profound

(adjective). thâm thúy

ex: There was a note of profound irritation in his voice.

transformation

(noun). sự biến đổi

ex: I'd never seen Jose in a tuxedo before - it was quite a transformation.

converge

(verb). tụ lại

ex: The paths all converge at the main gate of the park.

fundamentally

(adverb). về cơ bản

ex: I still believe that people are fundamentally good.

scope

(noun). phạm vi

ex: Oil painting does not come within the scope of a course of this kind.

incorporate

(verb). kết hợp

ex: This aircraft incorporates several new safety features.

arguable

(adjective). có thể tranh luận

ex: It is arguable which way is quicker.

fraught

(adjective). đầy

ex: From beginning to end, the airlift was fraught with risks.

innumerable

(adjective). vô số

ex: The project has been delayed by innumerable problems.

Consequently

(adverb). hậu quả là

ex: All the shops were closed, and consequently we couldn't buy any food.

Experiment

(noun). Thí nghiệm

ex: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.

(verb). chích thuốc

goldfish

(noun). cá vàng

ex: in the centre there is a large pond set in the marble pavement, full of goldfish

treatment

(noun). phép trị liệu

ex: Peter gets special treatment because he knows the boss.

pioneering

(adjective). tiên phong

ex: This pioneering work showed little development until about the middle of the 19th century.

synthesis

(noun). tổng hợp

ex: He describes his latest record as "a synthesis of African and Latin rhythms".

inhibitor

(noun). chất ức chế

ex: Studies should be carried out both in the presence and absence of an inhibitor of epoxide hydrolase

administer

(verb). quản lý

ex: The economy has been badly administered by the present government.

separate

(verb). tách rời

ex: You can get a special device for separating egg whites from yolks.

parallel

(noun). đường song song

ex: I'm trying to see if there are any obvious parallels between the two cases.

life span

(phrase). tuổi thọ

ex: The project's life span is estimated at about five years.

clinical

(adjective). lâm sàng

ex: clinical tests/training

handle

(verb). xử lý

ex: I thought he handled the situation very well.

remote

(adjective). Xa xôi

ex: remote galaxies

vice versa

ex: He doesn't trust her, and vice versa (= she also doesn't trust him).

consolidation

(noun). Sự hợp nhất

ex: The company is entering a period of consolidation.

staircase

(noun). cầu thang bộ

ex: A spiral staircase leads up to the second floor.

Prompt

(adjective). lập tức

ex: They've written back already - that was a very prompt reply.

Routine

ex: There's no set/fixed routine at work - every day is different.

ex: He may be unconsciously looking for a mother figure.

ex: A recurring knee injury may have impaired his chances of winning the tournament.

function

(noun). chức năng

ex: The function of the veins is to carry blood to the heart.

Complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

ex: The company has a complex organizational structure.

retain

(verb). retain

ex: She has lost her battle to retain control of the company.

implicitly

(adverb). ám chỉ

ex: Value tends to be implicitly communicated through packaging.

hypothesis

(noun). giả thuyết

ex: Several hypotheses for global warming have been suggested.

par

(noun). Sự ngang hàng

ex: About half the teachers are good, and the rest are clearly below par.

activate

(verb). kích hoạt

ex: The alarm is activated by the lightest pressure.

Subject

(noun). đối tượng

ex: Our subject for discussion is homelessness.

innovative

(adjective). sáng tạo

ex: innovative ideas/methods

stable

(adjective). ổn định

ex: After several part-time jobs, he's now got a stable job in a bank.

completion

(noun). hoàn thành

ex: You'll be paid on completion of the project.

region

(noun). khu vực

ex: The army has been brought in to maintain order in the region.

predominantly

(adverb). chủ yếu

ex: She is predominantly a dancer, but she also sings.

active

(adjective). hoạt động

ex: You have to try to keep active as you grow older.

prefrontal

(adjective). trước trán

ex: Synapses are lost during aging in the primate prefrontal cortex.

cortex

(noun). vỏ não

ex: The cortex of a young stem is usually green

motor

(noun). động cơ

ex: The pump is powered by a small electric motor.

neural

(adjective). thuộc về thần kinh

ex: Some people suffered severe neural damage as a result of the disease.

progress

(noun). sự tiến triển

ex: I'm not making much progress with my Spanish.

visual

(adjective). trực quan

ex: The rooms do not have much visual interest.

track

(verb). theo dõi

ex: It's difficult to track an animal over stony ground.

indicate

(verb). biểu thị

ex: Please indicate which free gift you would like to receive.

rat

(noun). con chuột

ex: Rats carry disease.

associate

(verb). liên kết

ex: Most people associate this brand with good quality.

specific

(adjective). riêng biệt

ex: The virus attacks specific cells in the brain.

extensive

(adjective). sâu rộng

ex: extensive repairs to the motorway

electrode

(noun). điện cực

ex: electrode array is inserted in the inner ear.

implant

(verb). cấy ghép

ex: He had a new heart valve implanted.

auditory

(adjective). thính giác

ex: The stroke impaired her auditory function but not her vision.

frequency

(noun). tần số

ex: the increasing frequency of terrorist attacks

selectivity

(noun). tính chọn lọc

ex: Selectivity has affected the type of students attending the school.

terminate

(verb). chấm dứt

ex: They terminated my contract in October.

evolutionary

(adjective). tiến hóa

ex: The change has been evolutionary rather than revolutionary.

lasting

(adjective). bền vững

ex: Did any of your teachers make a lasting impression on you?

intuitively

(adverb). trực giác

ex: Intuitively, it makes sense to start the project now.

susceptible

(adjective). nhạy cảm

ex: She isn't very susceptible to flattery.

disruption

(noun). gián đoạn

ex: The accident brought widespread disruption on the roads.

initiate

(verb). khởi xướng

ex: Who initiated the violence?

vertebrate

(noun). động vật có xương sống

ex: Birds, fish, and reptiles are all vertebrates.

mammalian

(noun). động vật có vú

ex: The mammalian remains found in Pleistocene deposits are of exceptional interest

enormously

(adverb). to lớn

ex: She worked enormously hard on the project.

mollusc

(noun). nhuyễn thể

ex: Oysters are molluscs, as are snails and cuttlefish.

similarity

(noun). giống nhau

ex: I can see the similarity between you and your mother.

species

(noun). loài

ex: Over a hundred species of insect are found in this area.

Laboratory

(noun). Phòng thí nghiệm

ex: Dean was led to a laboratory in the rear of the building

mild

(adjective). ôn hòa

ex: She can't accept even mild criticism of her work.

underlying

(adjective). nền tảng

ex: We need to tackle the underlying causes of poverty and suffering.

Electroconvulsive Therapy

(phrase). Liệu pháp Sốc điện

ex: When depression fails to respond to treatment or when there is a high risk of suicide, electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) is sometimes used.

biological

(adjective). sinh học

ex: Eating is a biological necessity!

improvement

(noun). cải tiến

ex: a slight improvement in the economy

cerebral

(adjective). thuộc về não

ex: She makes cerebral films that deal with important social issues.

lengthy

(adjective). Dài dòng

ex: His lengthy explanations are the more grievous

remarkable

(adjective). đáng chú ý

ex: The 20th century was remarkable for its inventions.

spare

(verb). bổ sung

ex: They asked him to spare the women and children.

neuroscientist

(noun). nhà thần kinh học

ex: Neuroscientists are able to record the firing of a single nerve cell.

put forward

(verb). đưa ra

ex: None of the ideas that I put forward have been accepted.

trip

(verb). vấp ngã

ex: He tripped and fell down, grazing his knee.

primarily

(adverb). chủ yếu

ex: The new scheme is aimed primarily at teenagers.

disorder

(noun). rối loạn

ex: The whole office was in a state of disorder.

functioning

(adjective). đang hoạt động

ex: It's what keeps the hospital functioning, so we can treat everyone who comes this way

induce

(verb). gây ra

ex: They induced her to take the job by promising editorial freedom.

emerge

(verb). hiện ra

ex: She emerged from the sea, blue with cold.

conserve

(verb). Giữ gìn

ex: To conserve electricity, we are cutting down on our heating.

compelling

(adjective). thuyết phục

ex: The novel was so compelling that I couldn't put it down

adaptive

(adjective). thích nghi

ex: Adaptive organizations rely on fast feedback from customers to respond to market changes.

neurobiological

(adjective). sinh học thần kinh

ex: The condition is neurobiological, affecting the way the brain processes information.

intriguing

(adjective). hấp dẫn

ex: She has a really intriguing personality.

consolidate

(verb). củng cố

ex: She hoped that marriage would consolidate their relationship.
